```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("qa_checklist.R")
```

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
cat("This is the checklist to work from when someone hands you an evaluation result and asks\n")
cat("whether to act on it. Every question is short and direct, so you can ask it out loud. For\n")
cat("every question, the analyst should either give an answer or admit that they cannot. A question\n")
cat("the analyst cannot answer is itself a finding, and sometimes the most important one.\n\n")

cat("The four areas below are the four places an evaluation most often goes wrong. Work through\n")
cat("them in order. If you only have five minutes, use the short list on the last page.\n\n")

cat("# The four areas\n\n")

for (d in qa_domains) {
  cat(sprintf("## %s\n\n", d))
  cat(sprintf("*%s*\n\n", qa_purpose[[d]]))
  qs <- qa_questions$question[qa_questions$domain == d]
  for (i in seq_along(qs)) {
    cat(sprintf("%d. %s\n", i, qs[i]))
  }
  cat("\n")
  cat("Answer / what the analyst said: ....................................................\n\n")
  cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
}

cat("\\newpage\n\n")

cat("# The five to ask every time\n\n")
cat("If the meeting is about to end and you have not asked anything yet, ask these.\n\n")
for (i in seq_along(qa_headline)) {
  cat(sprintf("%d. **%s**\n", i, qa_headline[i]))
}

cat("\n# Three habits that make the questions land\n\n")

cat("**Ask for the number, not the adjective.** \"Was it significant?\" invites a yes. \"What was\n")
cat("the estimate and its confidence interval?\" invites a figure you can check. An evaluator who\n")
cat("cannot produce the figure has not finished the analysis.\n\n")

cat("**Ask what would change your mind.** If no result could ever prove a claim wrong, the claim\n")
cat("is not a finding. Listen for a specific answer: a rate, a time horizon, a subgroup, a specification.\n\n")

cat("**Ask what you would do differently if it were half the size.** If the recommendation is the\n")
cat("same either way, the estimate is not what is driving the decision. Something else is driving\n")
cat("it, and you should find out what.\n\n")

cat("# Notes\n\n")
cat("Questions the analyst could not answer:\n\n")
cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
cat("What you would need before approving:\n\n")
cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
```
